Clone pseudobulk profiles

Source: R/clones_states.R
clone_profiles.Rd

Per clone x window (1 Mb, or size): depth log2 of the pooled counts (log2((sum x + 0.5) / (sum e + 0.5))), relative to the clean reference pool's pseudobulk when ref_cells has >= min_ref cells, then centred on the clone's autosomal median (states are relative to the clone baseline); SE = SD of the per-cell window log2 ratios / sqrt(cells) (combined with the reference SE). Haplotype fraction: the clone's cells are split into two random halves; each phase block is oriented on one half and counted on the other, summed per window: nA, nB, n_hap, f, f_se (binomial SE x the beta-binomial inflation 1 + (nbar - 1) * rho, nbar = molecule-weighted molecules per cell), and n_blocks.

Usage

clone_profiles(
  win,
  votes,
  atoms,
  assign,
  ref_cells = NULL,
  size = 1e+06,
  seed = 1,
  cells = colnames(win$x),
  rho = 0.01,
  allelic_chroms = NULL,
  haploid = character(),
  min_ref = 30
)

Arguments

win

1 Mb window depth: list(windows (window, chrom, start, end), x, e) with x / e windows x cells

votes, atoms

votes and atoms tables

assign

data.table cell, clone (cells used for each clone's pseudobulk)

ref_cells

reference pool cells (NULL = none)

size

window size (bp; a multiple of 1 Mb), one value or one per clone (named)

seed

RNG seed of the split halves

cells

cell names in vote index order (default the columns of win$x)

rho

beta-binomial overdispersion

allelic_chroms

chromosomes with an allele channel (NULL = all)

haploid

chromosomes with one copy in a normal cell (male chrX / chrY): ploidy 1

min_ref

minimal reference pool size

Value

data.table clone, window, chrom, start, end, ploidy, base (copy number of log2 = 0: the ploidy when relative to the pool, else 2), n_cells, log2, log2_se, nA, nB, n_hap, f, f_se, n_blocks, ref ("pool" or "median"), size
